title: Knowledge of Inborn Errors of Immunity Among Pediatric Physicians
off: Assessment of Knowledge Regarding Inborn Errors of Immunity Among Pediatric Physicians in Assiut: A Cross-Sectional Study

officials.a: Pediatrics Hematology department Faculty of Medicine, Assiut University

summary: This cross-sectional study aims to assess the level of knowledge regarding inborn errors of immunity among pediatric physicians working in Assiut Governorate, Egypt.
desc:
Inborn errors of immunity (IEI) are heterogeneous disorders that can present with recurrent, severe, or unusual infections, autoimmunity, and other manifestations. Early recognition by pediatric physicians is important for timely diagnosis and management.

This observational study will use a self-administered electronic questionnaire to assess knowledge of clinical warning signs, general and specific signs of IEI, and treatment and immunization strategies among pediatric physicians in Assiut.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \- Working as a pediatric physician in Assiut
* Practicing pediatrics in a participating hospital
* Willing to participate and able to complete the electronic questionnaire
* Providing informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* \- Refusal to participate
* Inadequate or substantially incomplete questionnaire response
* Not currently practicing pediatrics
* Participation in questionnaire development or validation

arms.d: Pediatric physicians working in Assiut who will complete a self-administered electronic questionnaire assessing knowledge of inborn errors of immunity.

primary.m: Overall knowledge score regarding inborn errors of immunity
